query_guidance.q010: Require documentary evidence that the book concerns the July 2024 revolution in Bangladesh. A generic movement or publication year alone does not establish this event.
query_guidance.q024: The user identifies the five as Shakib, Mashrafi, Tamim, Mushfiq, and Mahmudullah. A book centrally about any one or more of them can receive grade 3, when the exported metadata supports the life/story coverage. All five need not appear. Do not supply biographical facts from memory.
query_guidance.q030: For a documented Humayun Ahmed novel: grade 3 requires explicit evidence of writing in 1980-1989; grade 2 may use explicitly documented first publication in 1980-1989 when writing date is unknown. An edition publication year alone does not prove either fact: mark the date requirement unjudgeable when it is the only available date evidence. If metadata contradicts another explicit requirement, judge that documented mismatch under the normal rubric.
query_guidance.q025: Require catalogue evidence of scientists' lives/stories and discoveries for a direct strong match. General scientific theory alone does not establish life-story coverage, and an author's scientific profession alone does not establish this book's subject. Judge only the exported metadata.

rubric.0: Irrelevant, or documented evidence contradicts an explicit requirement.
rubric.1: Weak/tangential connection; the main intent is not substantially addressed.
rubric.2: Substantial match to the intent, supported by catalogue evidence.
rubric.3: Direct, strong match to the intent and explicit requirements, supported by evidence.

evidence_policy: Only exported catalogue metadata. No prior knowledge, generated enrichment, ranking scores, explanations, or external facts.
